title: Teach attention to read text in order
brief: Implement one step of location-sensitive attention, the stop-token loss, the guided attention loss, and a diagonality score, then train a toy Tacotron that reads strings of made-up phones aloud.
hints: guided_attention_weights: build t = arange(n_frames)[:, None] / n_frames and n = arange(n_text)[None, :] / n_text, and broadcasting gives the whole grid in one expression.

guided_attention_loss: build a boolean mask of valid cells from the two length vectors with arange(...) < lengths[:, None, None], fill a weight tensor utterance by utterance, and divide the masked sum by mask.sum().
stop_token_loss: the target row is (arange(T)[None, :] == lengths[:, None] - 1). F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(..., pos_weight=..., reduction='none') gives per-frame values you can mask.
location_sensitive_attention: F.conv1d(cumulative[:, None, :], kernel, padding=(K - 1) // 2) gives (B, F, N); transpose it to (B, N, F) before multiplying by W_location.T.
Fill the masked energies with float('-inf') before torch.softmax, so padded positions get exactly zero weight. torch.bmm(weights[:, None, :], memory) gives the context.
